tagline: Books on authority, capital and judgement in the age of machines that decide.
about: Institutional Signal Press publishes a connected list of books for leaders in capital markets, private equity and the institutions around them. Each title owns one central question, so the list reads as a single, deliberate argument rather than a shelf of overlapping takes.
author: Uttaran Chakrabarti
newsletter_blurb: Release dates, new titles and the occasional essay. No more than once a month.
